Streamwall bundles FFmpeg as a separate executable for HDHomeRun playback.

The Windows build uses the FFmpeg executable installed on the build machine.
Its exact version and build configuration can be read with `ffmpeg.exe -version`.
The Gyan Doshi build used for this release is licensed under GPL version 3.
Its license is included as FFmpeg-GPL-3.0.txt.

Build information and the corresponding FFmpeg source are available at:
https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/
https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg

FFmpeg is launched as a separate process only while an HDHomeRun stream is
displayed. Streamwall and FFmpeg remain separate programs.
